shortDescription: Infosys plans to move as much as a third of its workforce into roles of specialist - such as in AI, data and the domains in which the IT giant operates - who will be supported by a new skills framework and assessments, reports Beena Parmar.

title: Infosys to Turn 33% Workforce into Specialists
